description:
Let the user pick a file to parse: shows the AILANG Parse card with a
Choose file button. The card uploads the file and tries to summarise it
for you; either way you get its fileRef. Then call mcpParse with that
fileRef for the content (the same user can reuse it for 30 minutes; a large
document comes in parts). Use this when the user wants to pick a file, or
when createUpload's curl fails with a network error. For a file already in
your sandbox or workspace, use createUpload + curl instead.
Never parse the file yourself.
name: uploadDocument
title: Upload a document
